# GaiaWorks | Product Overview

GaiaWorks is an enterprise-level WFM for a complex front-line workforce, focused on intelligent scheduling, attendance, working hours costs and flexible labour. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
